[[Fairy Tale]] was released by {{Name|bi}} in 2000 and it's a point and click adventure for kids that was localised into many languages.

Before founding [[Bohemia Interactive]], the Španěl brothers released games for home computers: [[B.L.O.U.D]] for Atari 800XL, [[Invaze z Aldebaranu]] for Atari ST, and [[Gravon]] for Atari Falcon030.


[[Rio Grande]] is the first attempt of the Španěl brothers to create a 3D game for Windows PC, soon abandoned to follow up with the much more ambitious [[Poseidon]] engine that later evolved into [[Real Virtuality]], giving birth to {{GameCategory|ofp|link= y}}.
